obligations.title: Access matrix equals the approved access policy
obligations.statement: The application's access matrix is fully specified, default-deny, and equal to the approved access policy in controls/access-policy.json.
obligations.evidence_required: exhaustive control test over roles x actions passing on the final change

obligations.title: Privileged routes require MFA
obligations.statement: Every HTTP route whose action is privileged requires multi-factor authentication.
obligations.evidence_required: exhaustive control test over the route table passing on the final change

obligations.title: State-changing operations are audited
obligations.statement: Every state-changing operation writes an audit event recording actor, action, target and time.
obligations.evidence_required: control test; the sample test covers create and approve only

obligations.title: Change links an approved ticket covering the changed components
obligations.statement: Every change references a change ticket in status approved whose components include every component the change touches (components per controls/components.json).

obligations.title: Independent authorized approval
obligations.statement: Every change is approved by a code approver who is not the change's author. Identities are resolved through the directory, including aliases.
obligations.evidence_required: records: approvals.json code_review bound to the head commit, directory.json

obligations.title: Security review for security-sensitive components
obligations.statement: A change touching a component marked security_sensitive in controls/components.json needs an approved security_review from a person holding the security_reviewer role, bound to the head commit.
